merge_request.title: chore(deps): upgrade requests 2.28.2 -> 2.34.2
merge_request.description:
Upgrading requests from 2.28.2 to 2.34.2 involved adjusting type annotations and behavior due to upstream changes: Request.headers now uses MutableMapping without None, Response.reason is strictly str, headers input reverted to Mapping to prevent variance issues, _get_connection was replaced by get_connection_with_tls_context, and duplicate leading slashes in URI paths are now preserved. The test suite passes fully after these updates, with only requirements.txt modified to reflect the new version.

## What changed

- requests 2.28.2 -> 2.34.2 in requirements.txt

## Documented changes that applied to this codebase

- **deprecation**: 2.34.1: Request.headers typing changed to MutableMapping; None removed from typing (requests, requests.HTTPError)
  > Changed headers input type to MutableMapping and removed None from Request.headers typing to improve handling for users. (#7431) [↗](https://requests.readthedocs.io/en/latest/community/updates/#id2)
- **deprecation**: 2.34.1: Response.reason type narrowed from str | None to str (requests.HTTPError)
  > Response.reason moved from str | None to str to improve handling for users. (#7437) [↗](https://requests.readthedocs.io/en/latest/community/updates/#id2)
- **deprecation**: 2.34.2: headers input type moved back to Mapping to avoid invariance issues (requests, requests.HTTPError)
  > Moved headers input type back to Mapping to avoid invariance issues with MutableMapping and inferred dict types. Users calling Request.headers.update() may need to narrow typing in their code. (#7441) [↗](https://requests.readthedocs.io/en/latest/community/updates/#id1)
- **deprecation**: 2.32.2: _get_connection deprecated in favor of get_connection_with_tls_context (requests)
  > To provide a more stable migration for custom HTTPAdapters impacted by the CVE changes in 2.32.0, we've renamed _get_connection to a new public API, get_connection_with_tls_context. Existing custom HTTPAdapters will need to migrate their code to use this new API. get_connection is considered depreca [↗](https://requests.readthedocs.io/en/latest/community/updates/#id9)
- **behavior**: 2.34.0: Duplicate leading slashes preserved in URI paths (behavior change) (requests.HTTPError, requests.get)
  > Requests no longer incorrectly strips duplicate leading slashes in URI paths. This should address user issues with specific presigned URLs. Note the full fix requires urllib3 2.7.0+. (#7315) [↗](https://github.com/psf/requests/blob/main/HISTORY.md#2340-2026-05-11 and https://requests.readthedocs.io/en/latest/community/updates/#id3)

sources.title: Update dependency requests to '>=v2.33.0,<2.34.0' [SECURITY] · Issue #247 · OpenAEV-Platform/client-python · GitHub

entries.title: 2.34.1: Request.headers typing changed to MutableMapping; None removed from typing
entries.migration: Request.headers now expects MutableMapping; passing None or non-MutableMapping may trigger type warnings. Code using `requests.get(...).headers.update(...)` may need to narrow typing annotations.
entries.quote: Changed headers input type to MutableMapping and removed None from Request.headers typing to improve handling for users. (#7431)

entries.title: 2.34.1: Response.reason type narrowed from str | None to str
entries.migration: Response.reason is now always str (never None). Code catching HTTPError that checks for None on .reason may need adjustment.
entries.quote: Response.reason moved from str | None to str to improve handling for users. (#7437)

entries.title: 2.34.2: headers input type moved back to Mapping to avoid invariance issues
entries.migration: Users calling Request.headers.update() may need to narrow typing in their code. The type was briefly MutableMapping in 2.34.1, now adjusted back toward Mapping.
entries.quote: Moved headers input type back to Mapping to avoid invariance issues with MutableMapping and inferred dict types. Users calling Request.headers.update() may need to narrow typing in their code. (#7441)

entries.title: 2.32.2: _get_connection deprecated in favor of get_connection_with_tls_context
entries.migration: Custom HTTPAdapters using `_get_connection` must migrate to `get_connection_with_tls_context`. The old `_get_connection` is deprecated in Requests>=2.32.0.
entries.quote: To provide a more stable migration for custom HTTPAdapters impacted by the CVE changes in 2.32.0, we've renamed _get_connection to a new public API, get_connection_with_tls_context. Existing custom HTTPAdapters will need to migrate their code to use this new API. get_connection is considered deprecated in all versions of Requests>=2.32.0.

entries.title: 2.34.0: Duplicate leading slashes preserved in URI paths (behavior change)
entries.migration: N/A - this is a URL normalization behavior change; code that relied on duplicate slashes being stripped will now see them preserved. Use urllib.parse.urljoin for safe URL construction.
entries.quote: Requests no longer incorrectly strips duplicate leading slashes in URI paths. This should address user issues with specific presigned URLs. Note the full fix requires urllib3 2.7.0+. (#7315)

entries.title: 2.33.0: extract_zipped_paths security fix (non-default utility function)
entries.migration: N/A - only affects direct callers of requests.utils.extract_zipped_paths, not standard requests usage.
entries.quote: CVE-2026-25645 requests.utils.extract_zipped_paths now extracts contents to a non-deterministic location to prevent malicious file replacement. This does not affect default usage of Requests, only applications calling the utility function directly.

entries.title: 2.33.0: Dropped support for Python 3.9
entries.migration: N/A - only affects projects supporting Python 3.9.
entries.quote: Dropped support for Python 3.9 following its end of support.

payload.summary: Between 2.28.2 and 2.34.2, the most significant change affecting this codebase is the 2.34.0 URL path normalization change that preserves duplicate leading slashes, which is a behavior change. The 2.32.2 deprecation of `_get_connection` in favor of `get_connection_with_tls_context` is also relevant if custom adapters are used. The 2.34.1 change to `Request.headers` typing (MutableMapping, removal of None) and `Response.reason` type narrowing are deprecations/warnings. The 2.33.0 security fix for `extract_zipped_paths` and Python 3.9 drop are noise for this upgrade. No breaking API changes that require code changes were found beyond the URL path behavior shift and the deprecation warnings.
